# Part B

# B1
```{r}
students <- data.frame(
            id = 1:8,
            name = c("Alice","Bruno","Chen","Dana","Elif","Farid","Grace","Hiro"),
            sex = c("F","M","M","F","F","M","F","M"),
            section = c("A","B","A","C","B","C","A","B"),
            midterm = c(78,85,92,67,74,88,95,59),
            final = c(82,79,96,71,80,91,93,65),
            attendance = c(95,88,100,72,90,85,98,60),
            stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```

# B2
```{r}
str(students)
dim(students)
names(students)
summary(students)
```

# B3
```{r}
students$average <- round((students$midterm + students$final) / 2, 1)
print(students)
```

# B4
```{r}
students$passed <- students$average >= 70 & students$attendance >= 75
print(students)
```

# B5
```{r}
students$standing <- ifelse(students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                     ifelse(students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

print(students)
```

# B6
```{r}
classify <- function(score) {
  if (score >= 85) {
    return("Distinction")
  } else if (score >= 70) {
    return("Merit")
  } else if (score >= 50) {
    return("Pass")
  } else {
    return("Fail")
  }
}

result <- sapply(c(90,73,55,40), classify)
print(result)
```


# Part C
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
                id = c(9, 10),
                name = c("Ines","Jamal"),
                sex = c("F","M"),
                section = c("C","A"),
                midterm = c(81,70),
                final = c(84,68),
                attendance = c(92,80),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                )
```


# C1
```{r}
new_students <- data.frame(
                id = c(9,10),
                name = c("Ines","Jamal"),
                sex = c("F","M"),
                section = c("C","A"),
                midterm = c(81,70),
                final = c(84,68),
                attendance = c(92,80),
                stringsAsFactors = FALSE
                )

new_students$average <- round((new_students$midterm + new_students$final) / 2, 1)
new_students$passed <- new_students$average >= 70 & new_students$attendance >= 75

new_students$standing <- ifelse(new_students$average >= 90, "Honors",
                         ifelse(new_students$average >= 75, "Good", "Needs Support"))

students_all <- rbind(students, new_students)
print(students_all)
```

# C2
```{r}
quiz <- c(8, 7, 10, 6, 7, 9, 10, 5, 8, 6)

students_all <- cbind(students_all, quiz = quiz)

print(students_all)
print(class(students_all))
```

# C3
```{r}
m <- cbind(midterm = students_all$midterm, final = students_all$final)

m <- rbind(m, mean = colMeans(m))

print(m)
```

# C4
```{r}
tryCatch(rbind(students, bad), error = function(e) { message("rbind failed: ", conditionMessage(e)); NULL })
```
# rbind() requires both data frames to have the exact same column names. If the names are different, R stops and gives the error "names do not match previous names".

          students_all,

# D5
```{r}

lowest_student  <- students_all$name[which.min(students_all$average)]

print(highest_student)
print(lowest_student)
```

# D6
```{r}

print(head(sorted_students, 3))
```

# Part E

# E1
```{r}
students_all$section <- factor(students_all$section)
students_all$sex     <- factor(students_all$sex)

print(levels(students_all$section))
print(levels(students_all$sex))
```

# E2
```{r}
print(table(students_all$sex))
print(table(students_all$section))

print(table(students_all$sex, students_all$section))
```

# E3
```{r}
print(as.integer(students_all$sex))
```
# R stores factor values as whole integers mapped alphabetically to its levels. Here, 1 represents the first level ("F") and 2 represents the second level ("M").

# E4
```{r}
students_all$sex_label <- factor(
                          students_all$sex,
                          levels = c("F","M"),
                          labels = c("Female","Male")
                                )

print(levels(students_all$sex_label))
```

# E5
```{r}
print(summary(students_all$sex_label))

mean_female <- mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Female"])
mean_male   <- mean(students_all$average[students_all$sex_label == "Male"])

print(mean_female)
print(mean_male)
```
